records.source_paraphrase: Seven classical planets in twelve houses are each assigned broad body, kinship, livelihood, reputation and character outcomes.
records.qualifier: 84 cells in a 7×12 grammar are dependent, multi-label claims, not 84 independent successful predictions.

records.source_paraphrase: The chapter explicitly qualifies malefic/benefic outcomes by difficult houses 6/8/12, planetary strength, friendships, aspects, exaltation or fall.

records.source_paraphrase: Each unordered pair among seven classical planets is described separately when jointly in 1st,4th,7th,10th houses.
records.qualifier: 21 pairs ×4 angle categories, with text v87 extending conjecturally to 3–6 planet conjunctions. Not an independent human evaluation.

records.source_paraphrase: Three/four planets strongly dignified allegedly promote rulers born in a royal family, while five/six may promote others; one/two yields weaker noble status.
records.qualifier: Text explicitly conditions on birth class/opportunity. Royal ancestry must not be used as an evaluative moral measure.

records.source_paraphrase: Yavanas reportedly infer cruel rulership when only malefics exalted; Jeevasarma predicts courage but not kingship; Kalyana Varma sides with leadership/honor.
records.qualifier: Direct historically named disagreement; do not choose flattering variant after seeing subject.

records.source_paraphrase: Adhi Yoga is based on benefics in sixth, seventh, eighth from Moon but excludes Sun from these and requires no malefic aspects.

records.source_paraphrase: One source school assigns exalted rays [Sun10,Moon9,Mars5,Mercury5,Jupiter7,Venus8,Saturn5]; another gives all seven planets 7 rays.
records.qualifier: Both distributions sum to 49, but individuals' totals differ for intermediate positions. Schools are computational variants.

records.source_paraphrase: Planetary ray counts are interpolated between highest exaltation and fall, then modified by decanate/D12 dignity, retrogradation, combustion and direction.
records.qualifier: Rays cannot be computed from exaltation alone; double/treble and other exceptions must be frozen.

records.qualifier: Sun/Moon are not members of these five; pair source positions with exact chart convention before testing.
